conditions: Both functions differentiable at the point; derivatives with respect to the same variable.
spoken_aliases: the derivative of the product of u and v equals u prime times v plus u times v prime
open parenthesis u times v close parenthesis prime equals u prime times v plus u times v prime

evidence: Write the increment of uv as u times the increment of v plus v times the increment of u plus their increment product, evaluated at the base point. Divide by h. Differentiability makes both increments O(h), so the product term divided by h tends to zero, giving u v'+v u'.
